usedFor: Cal.com holds bookings, and MSG91 opens a ticket when “Booking Created” runs “Send Mail via Hello”.

bestTemplate.name: “Booking Created” in Cal.com, then “Send Mail via Hello” in MSG91
bestTemplate.why: Each new booking gets a ticket, so your team has one place to follow it up.

watchOut: “Booking Reschedules” and “Booking Is Cancelled” are separate triggers, so each needs its own template.
